title: Hemolytic Solution
subtitle: The foundation of purification
text: Hemolytic Solution is an early rite material, not a drink. An actively blooded candidate uses it at an Unstained Podium to suppress the infection before Lethean Baptism. Healthy novitiates learn to distill it in the Pallid Retort during the Gentle Separation. It can also be crafted with stone to make Cleansed Stone.
